document.title: Fullbleed Canonical Reference
document.subtitle: Static PDF library reference for component scaffolds, assets, CSS layers, and validation output

pipeline.description: Keep document assembly, components, data, styles, assets, and outputs in separate folders.
Build pages through Fullbleed UI elements and local domain components.
Load tokens first, component styles next, and final report overrides last.
Register fonts and SVG files with AssetBundle; pass raster images as local files or data URIs.
Smoke-render mounted components, scan CSS layers, and emit diagnostic JSON before final PDF output.
Emit HTML, CSS, PDF, PNG previews, page data, and run reports from one command.

scaffold.purpose: The executable pipeline and single source for render settings.
Structured input data; replace with CSV, JSON, or database loaders in real projects.
Pure component functions that return Fullbleed UI elements.
Component-scoped CSS layers with reusable selectors.
Global tokens and final report-level composition CSS.
Local SVG, image, and font inputs registered through AssetBundle or embedded as data URIs.
Generated artifacts only; safe to clean and regenerate.

known_limits.detail: Transitions, animations, hover input, and script-driven layouts remain static-output contracts.
This example targets reliable static PDFs, not complete browser behavior.
Production scaffolds should vendor or bundle assets for deterministic rendering.
